As a pensioner who has been a patient at several medical practices throughout my life, I feel it is important to recognise truly exceptional healthcare professionals when we encounter them. In all my years, I have only come across three doctors who stand out as truly remarkable, and two of them are here at Elliott Hall Medical Centre Surgery.
Dr Najah Pandit (f) and Dr Ashok Kelshiker (m) are not only excellent medical professionals, but also genuinely kind and compassionate human beings. They take the time to listen carefully to their patients and provide thoughtful, well-considered medical advice based on what they hear. That quality of attentive listening is rare and deeply appreciated.
What is equally impressive is their ability to manage time efficiently while never making patients feel rushed. During consultations, one feels heard, respected, and properly cared for.
I would also like to thank the general staff at Elliott Hall Medical Centre Surgery, who are always supportive and helpful. Their professionalism and kindness contribute greatly to the positive experience patients have at the practice.
My sincere thanks and appreciation to everyone at Elliott Hall Medical Centre Surgery, and especially to Dr Najah Pandit and Dr Ashok Kelshiker. May God bless them to continue being excellent in their profession and to remain the compassionate human beings that they clearly are.
